thread:
elaine: Heads up 1 release cut is on hold. CI verify failed for the package upload (checksum mismatch) and deploy-bot aborted the promote.

ci-bot: [automated] verify-step failed: expected=sha256:12345678 got=sha256:12ff5678. See job 8050 logs: https://ci.internal/8050/logs

ryan: Which ref was that? Can we fallback to last-known-good?

elaine: It was redwood/embeddings@2026-03-28-rc3. Last-known-good is redwood/embeddings@2026-03-26-rc9.

ops-oncall: Checking cache-writer and the object-cache. I see several partial PUTs around 09:12UTC from runner-9. Restarting cache-writer to clear stuck connections.

sam: If the rerun succeeds we can re-promote, but our change window starts at 10:00UTC. I'd rather pin to rc9 now to avoid delaying the window.

elaine: Agreed. Pin to rc9 and record in the release notes that rc3 failed artifact verification; we'll reattempt after the window.

ryan: Opening promote now: /promote redwood/embeddings@2026-03-26-rc9 --reason "manual pin after rc3 artifact verify failure"

deploy-bot: Promotion queued. Running pre-promotion checks.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete  redwood/embeddings@2026-03-26-rc9 is promoted to candidate. Release notes updated: "Pinned to last-known-good after artifact verification failure on newer candidate."

ci-bot: job 8050 (rerun) started on runner-9.

ci-bot: job 8050 (rerun) finished: SUCCESS. Uploaded artifact verified on rerun.

elaine: Rerun succeeded but we've already pinned to keep the change window. Action items: sam - create ISSUE-1015 to investigate partial PUTs from runner-9 and add checksum preflight in uploader; ops-oncall - monitor cache-writer for recurrence; ryan - coordinate secondary promotion post-release.

sam: ISSUE-1015 filed with logs and initial triage. I'll pick it up after the release.

ops-oncall: Monitoring now. Will collect tcpdump if partial PUTs reappear.

elaine: Thanks team. We'll reconvene here if anything changes. :thumbsup:
